m: √ 1. प्राश् (प्र- 1. अश्) P. प्राश्नोति (aor. प्रानट्), to reach, attain, RV.; to fall to the lot or share of (acc.), ib. : Caus. प्राशापयति, to cause to reach or attain, MānGṛ.
√ 2. प्राश् (प्र- 2. अश्) P. प्राश्नाति (rarely Ā. ˚नीते), to eat, consume, devour, taste, enjoy, RV. &c. &c.: Caus. प्राशयति, to cause to eat, feed, ĀśvGṛ.; Mn.; Kathās.
3. प्राश् m. (√ प्रछ्) asking, inquiring, a questioner, Yājñ., Sch. (cf. शब्द-प्र्˚ and Uṇ. ii, 57)
प्राश् f. (?) statement or assertion in a debate or lawsuit, AV. ii, 27, 1; 5 (cf. प्रति-प्राश्).
a: प्राश् — {c9c} P. 1 To eat, consume, devour, feed upon. --2 To taste; Ms. 2. 62. --3 To enjoy, sport with. --4 To drink.

m: प्राशा (प्र-आशा) f. ardent desire or longing for, TāṇḍBr.; Mālatīm.

v: na॰ praSAstarBAvaH karma vA udgA॰ aY । praSAsturftvijaH karmaRi 1 SastraSaMsane 2 tadBAve ca ।
m: प्रा—शास्त्र n. the office of Praśāstṛ, KātyŚr. (cf. g. उद्गात्र्-आदि)
government, rule, dominion, MW.
a: प्राशास्त्रं — 1 The office of a Praśāstṛ. --2 Government, rule.

m: प्राशातिक n. a leguminous plant, ĀpŚr.
1. प्राशू m. (for 2. See below) an eater, guest (?), RV. i, 40, 5 (Mahīdh. ‘very swift’ = शीघ्र cf. प्राशु).
2. प्राशू m. (for 1. See under 2. प्राश्) = परा-क्रम, TBr., Sch. (cf. सत्य-प्र्˚).
प्राश m. eating, feeding upon (cf. घृत-, धूम-प्र्˚)
food, victuals, Kauś.; MBh.; Suśr.
a: प्राशः — 1 Eating, tasting, living or feeding on; Ms. 11. 144; धूम˚ &c. --2 Food.

m: प्राशक m. eating, enjoying, Sāy. on RV. i, 40, 1.
प्राश˚नार्थीय mfn. meant for food, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
प्राशनी f. enjoyment, (cf. रस-प्र्˚), Vait.
प्राशनीय mfn. to be eaten, eatable, serving as food
प्राशनीय n. food, MBh.; R.
a: प्राशनीय — a. Eatable, serving as food. --यं Food.

v: na॰ pra + aSA--BAve lyuw । annAdeH prakarzeRa Bojane annaprASanam ।
m: प्राशन n. eating, feeding upon, tasting, GṛŚrS. &c. &c.
(fr. Caus.) causing to eat, feeding (esp. the first feeding of a child; cf. अन्न-प्र्˚), Mn.; Yājñ.
food, victuals (cf. अमृत-प्र्˚), MBh.; R.; Hariv.
a: प्राशनं — 1 Eating, feeding upon, tasting. --2 Causing to eat, or taste; Ms. 2. 29. --3 Food.

m: प्राश˚निन् mfn. See पर्ण- and प्राण-प्राशनिन्.
प्रा—शस्त्य n. (fr. -शस्त) the being praised, celebrity, excellence, Mālatīm.; Kathās.
प्राशस्त्य &c. See under 3. प्रा, p. 702, col. 3.
प्राशव्य n. (fr. प्राश् or प्राश) food, provisions, RV.

v: tri॰ prakfzwaM SfNgamasya vede dIrGaH । prakfzwaSfNgayukte yaju॰ 24 । 37
m: प्रा—शृङ्ग mfn. having the horns bent forwards, VS.; TS.
प्राशिन् See अमृत-प्र्˚.

s: klI, (prakarzeRa aSitaM yatra .) pitfyajYaH । iti jawADaraH ॥ (pra + aS + karmmaRi ktaH .) Bakzite, tri ॥
v: tri॰ pra + aSa--Bojana karmaRi kta । 1 Bakzite । BAve kta । 2 BakzaRe na॰ 3 pitfyajYe tarpaRe jawA॰ “prASitaM pitftarpaRam” manunA tatrArTe pariBAzitatvAt ।
m: प्राशित mfn. eaten, tasted, devoured, TS. &c. &c.
प्राशित n. the daily oblation to deceased progenitors, Mn. iii, 74.
a: प्राशित — p. p. Eaten, tasted, consumed. --तं 1 An offering of rice and water to the Manes of deceased ancestors, daily obsequies to the Manes; प्राशितं पितृतर्पणं Ms. 3. 74. --2 Eating.

m: प्राशितव्य mfn. to be eaten, eatable, esculent, ŚBr.; MBh.
प्राशितृ mfn. one who eats, an eater, AV.; MBh.

v: prASitraM hriyate'nena hf--karaRe lyuw । prASitrarUpaBAgaharaRasADane gokarRAkftipAtraBede Sata॰ brA॰ 1 । 3 । 1 । 6 BAzyam ।

m: प्राशित्र n. the portion of Havis eaten by the Brahman at a sacrifice, TS.; ŚBr.; ŚrS. (-वत् ind., Vait.)
= -हरण, BhP.
anything edible, W.
a: प्राशित्रं — 1 The portion of oblation partaken by Brahman at a sacrifice. --2 The vessel in which this oblation is placed. --3 Anything eatable.

m: प्राशित्र—हरण n. a vessel in which the Brahman's portion of Havis is placed, Śr.; GṛŚrS.
प्राशित्र—वत् ind., Vait.
प्राशि˚त्रिय mfn. See अ-प्राशित्रिय.
प्रा—श्लिष्ट mf(ई)n. N. of a kind of Svarita produced by the combination of 2 short इ's, APrāt. (w.r. प्राक्-श्ल्˚).
प्राश्नी-पुत्र m. N. of a teacher, ŚBr.

s: puM, (praSnAya taduttarapradAnAya sADuriti । praSna + Wak .) saByaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ praSnakarttari, tri ॥
v: pu॰ praSnAya taduttaradAnAya sADu Wak । 1 sanye trikA॰ 2 praSnottaradAnAya kADO tri॰ ।
m: प्राश्निक mf(ई)n. (fr. प्रश्न) containing questions (cf. बहु-प्र्˚)
प्राश्निक m. an inquirer, arbitrator, umpire, MBh.; R.; Mālav.
a witness, L.
an assistant at a spectacle or assembly (?), W.
a: प्राश्निक — a. Containing questions. --कः 1 An examiner. --2 An umpire, an arbitrator, a judge; अहो प्रयोगाभ्यंतरः प्राशिनकः M. 2; तद्भगवत्या प्राश्निकपदमध्यासितव्यं M. 1.

m: प्रा—श्रवण v.l. for -स्रवण m.

v: pu॰ pra + aSa--Bojane uR । BakzaRe prASave hitaH yat । prASavya prakfzwaBakzaRahite f॰ 8 । 31 । 6 BA॰ । prA॰ sa॰ । 2 prakfzwaSIGre nihaRwuH ।
m: प्राशु mfn. (प्र-आशु) very quick or speedy, RV. (= क्षिप्र, Naigh. i, 15)
प्राशु ind. (उ) quickly, swiftly, ĀpŚr.
a: प्राशु — a. Ved. Exceedingly quick or swift. --शुः 1 Eating. --2 One who eats Soma. --3 An enemy of Vṛtra.

m: प्राशु—षह् (-षाह्) mfn. (prob.) swiftly finishing (a meal), RV. iv, 25, 6 (‘rapidly victorious’, Sāy.)
प्राश्वमेध (प्र-अश्व्˚) m. a preliminary horse sacrifice, Kathās.
प्रा-श्वस् (प्र-आ-√ श्वस्), Caus. -श्वासयते, to comfort, console, R.
प्राश्य mfn. to be eaten, eatable, TBr.; KātyŚr.; R.
